brief:
# 汪家夫妻 EP5〈搶被子〉

## 故事前提

阿福半夜把整條棉被捲在身上打呼，珍珠只剩床邊一隻發抖的腳。隔天早上阿福睡在角落的寵物軟墊、只蓋一條粉紅小毛巾；珍珠把棉被、地毯、浴室踏墊、窗簾全捲在身上，捲成佔滿整張床的大被捲。阿福把小毛巾拉上來蓋頭，腳就露出來；縮腳，頭又露出來。

## 角色

- 阿福（afu）、珍珠（zhenzhu）：同系列定裝照。s01 的珍珠只有床邊一隻柴犬腳。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；集數規劃盲評 79（`docs/videos/wangjia-couple/episodes.md` 的 EP4）。採納評審建議：s02 砍到 1.6 秒；s05 毛巾蓋頭露腳、縮腳露頭來回一次，陽光正好打在他臉上。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 13 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：搶被子
一行說明：捲走整條被 → 老婆發抖、眼皮跳 → 睡寵物軟墊蓋小毛巾 → 老婆捲成整張床的大被捲 → 毛巾蓋頭露腳、縮腳露頭。
開場鉤子：由上往下看，整條棉被捲成一條只露鼻子的柯基被捲。

shots.ff: Top-down wide shot of a double bed at night in a dim bedroom: A-Fu the Corgi himself is rolled up inside the entire duvet like a giant burrito, only his nose sticking out, asleep; the other half of the bed is bare sheet; at the bed edge a single Shiba paw is visible, shivering.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> snores inside the duvet roll, the roll rising and falling with each breath; the single Shiba paw at the bed edge shivers. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium close-up in a dark bedroom of Zhenzhu the Shiba herself sitting up in bed with no blanket, hugging herself and shivering, four pink plastic hair curlers on her head.
shots.clip: The Shiba shown in <Picture 1> shivers and lets out a small puff of white breath; one eyelid twitches twice; she slowly turns her head toward the right. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Wide shot of a sunny bedroom corner in the morning: A-Fu the Corgi himself sleeps curled up inside a round pet bed cushion on the floor in his striped pyjamas, covered only by a tiny pink hand towel, his short legs sticking out.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> sleeps in the round pet bed; in his sleep he grabs at the air for a blanket and catches nothing; the tiny towel slips off his legs. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Top-down wide shot of the same double bed in bright morning sun: Zhenzhu the Shiba herself is rolled up inside one gigantic roll that fills the whole bed, with visible layers of a duvet, a patterned living room rug, a bath mat and curtains; only her nose and one pink hair curler stick out; she sleeps blissfully; the window has no curtains and sunlight blazes in.
shots.clip: The Shiba shown in <Picture 1> sleeps blissfully inside the gigantic roll; the roll slowly rises and falls with her breath; dust floats in the bright sunlight. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Close-up of A-Fu the Corgi himself curled up in the round pet bed in his striped pyjamas, a tiny pink hand towel over him, one eye open, a bright beam of morning sunlight across his face.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> pulls the tiny pink towel up over his whole head and his short hind paws pop out uncovered; he tucks his paws in and his head pops out again into the sunlight; he freezes, squinting. The camera holds a static shot.
